plane-page.title: Border Crossing and Obtaining a Migration Card
plane-page.description_for_near_abroad:
# 🟦 Near Abroad (Visa-Free Entry)
For citizens of Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Armenia, Belarus.
## 📋 Main Point at this Stage
**Migration card** is the primary document confirming the legality of your border crossing.

📍 It is issued **free of charge** directly at border checkpoints.
Main checkpoints are marked with a blue circle on the map.

## 📑 Documents to Have with You

- ✅ **International passport** (or ID card, if permitted)
- ✅ **Migration card** (with **"Education" / "Учеба"** mark)

---

## ⚠️ Important!

If you have been to the Russian Federation earlier this year:

1. Check for any **unpaid traffic fines (GIBDD)** via the Ministry of Internal Affairs website
2. Otherwise, you may be **denied entry** at the checkpoint
plane-page.description_for_far_abroad:
# 🟥 Far Abroad (Visa Entry)

> For citizens of China, India, Egypt, Turkey, and other countries.

---

## 📋 Entry Process

1. **Obtaining a student visa** in your country of residence
2. **Migration card** — issued at the border

---

## 📑 Documents to Obtain a Visa

- ✅ **Original UrFU invitation letter** (electronic or paper copy)
- ✅ **International passport** (valid for **at least 1.5 years**)
- ✅ **HIV-negative certificate**
- ✅ **Completed application form** and **photos**

---

## ⚠️ Important

> **The visa must be issued BEFORE entering Russia!**

You will not be allowed into the Russian Federation without a valid visa.

---

## 📌 Memo

| What | Where to get |
|-----|---------------|
| 🎓 **UrFU Invitation** | Sent via e-mail |
| 🛂 **Student Visa** | At the Russian Consulate in your country |
| 📄 **Migration Card** | At the border or airport |
| 🏥 **HIV-Negative Certificate** | At a medical center in your country |

---

> 💡 **Tip:** Start your visa application in advance; the process can take up to 4-6 weeks.
